name: Fixed-ledger versus moving-ledger criterion

objects.A_Z_n: finite visible zero/root ledger at stage n
objects.B_n: obstruction budget from EF domination and source coercivity

statuses.fixed_ledger: one completed A_Z is squeezed by all stages
statuses.exhaustive_ledger: finite ledgers plus vanishing tail squeeze A_Z
statuses.moving_ledger_support_only: stagewise finite ledgers are squeezed with no completed tail record
statuses.failed_visibility: A_Z=0 does not imply fixed-locus confinement

main_implication: A_Z <= B_n for all n and tr(B_n)->0 implies A_Z=0
RH_question: Can the zeta strict-extension ladder produce a fixed or exhaustive anti-invariant zero-ledger squeeze?
